title: Board Hover Sync Across Windows
description: Fix board hover in play mode: hover currently shows nothing and must be synchronized across all board windows in play. Inspect existing board hover state, play window bindings, and rendering chrome; patch existing files only and validate with targeted tests or runtime checks.
summary: Fixed board play hover propagation so canvas hover events are authoritative for the shared play hover state and synchronize the hovered id across all panes. Added a board canvas debug attribute for current hover id and a Playwright regression check that hovers a real node and verifies every board pane reports the same hover id. Verification: `bun nx test @elements/board` passed Rust tests and Vitest; Playwright new hover sync test passed. The full target still exits nonzero due two unrelated existing Playwright assertions in board-play-gpu.spec.ts: background context-menu expectation receives the menu item, and redraw toolbar expectation looks for a missing Redraw label/buttons.
